title: New Osmind AI Helps Psychiatry Practices Bring Innovative Treatments to More Patients
summary: Woven throughout the Osmind platform and backed by in-house experts, Osmind Intelligence streamlines the complexity of specialty care and breakthrough treatments
body_markdown:
SAN FRANCISCO--([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261112078189/en/New-Osmind-AI-Helps-Psychiatry-Practices-Bring-Innovative-Treatments-to-More-Patients) )-- **Osmind** , the platform powering the largest network of interventional psychiatry practices, today launched[Osmind Intelligence](https://www.osmind.org/ai) , AI woven into the Osmind platform and shaped by experience supporting more than 1,000 psychiatry practices and the 1 million treatments they’ve delivered. Osmind Intelligence helps run practice operations across clinical and administrative work: it surfaces patients who may benefit from further evaluation, drafts clinical notes, suggests billing codes, and automates compliance workflows.


[An estimated 2.8 million U.S. adults have depression that hasn’t adequately responded to multiple medications](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33989464/) , yet administrative burden keeps many independent practices from offering interventional treatments. Without automation, compliance filings and multi-week authorizations turn into after-hours charting, denied claims, and stalled growth for the practices delivering care.


“Psychiatry is entering a period of rapid innovation, and practices have too often been left behind because the burden of delivering new treatments is simply too high,” said Lucia Huang, co-founder and CEO of Osmind. “Every treatment a practice adds brings more clinical documentation and payer requirements. Osmind Intelligence takes on that operational work, so practices can grow and offer their patients more treatment options.”


Osmind Intelligence works inside Osmind’s HIPAA-compliant platform where practices already document, bill, and manage treatment, giving it the full patient context. The AI is continuously informed by Osmind’s in-house medical, revenue cycle, and operations experts—the same team that supports practices using Osmind’s billing and operational services.


Osmind Intelligence works across the patient journey to address the clinical and operational demands of specialty behavioral health and interventional psychiatry:


- **Before the visit,** it checks coverage, prepares prior authorizations, and surfaces patients for whom further evaluation may be appropriate.


- **During the visit,** it captures the session and drafts the note in the clinician’s own template, from a 15-minute med check to an interventional procedure. Clinicians review, edit, and sign every note. It is designed to save clinicians more than an hour a day.


- **After the visit,** it builds the claim from the signed note and prepares required compliance documentation for specialty treatments. For example, automating REMS submissions is estimated to save a high-volume SPRAVATO® practice over 20 hours a month.
‍


“AI only works as well as the context it has,” said William Sauvé, MD, chief medical officer of Osmind. “Osmind Intelligence works inside the platform where each patient’s record already lives, so it has the context to draft notes and identify patients who may meet treatment criteria. Clinicians review what it prepares instead of starting from scratch. Their time goes to the decisions only they can make.”


Early access to Osmind Intelligence is available starting today. Learn more at[osmind.org/ai](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.osmind.org%2Fai&esheet=54640151&newsitemid=20261112078189&lan=en-US&anchor=osmind.org%2Fai&index=4&md5=9be5e419f2ffde86c43262f606512c0d) .
